data.name: Rascal's Escape
data.detailed_description:
A COSY CO-OP ADVENTURE

Join the nimble Squirrel and the strong Bear on a wild journey. Jump, stomp, zoom through colorful cities following Rascal's clues. Travel Europe with your friends and experience nuttastic moments.

JUMP, STOMP & MUNCH!

Join the nimble Squirrel and the strong Bear. Jump, stomp and munch. Climb famous sights, harvest fruits and nuts. Move trees, trudge through mud or carry giant cakes.

HAVE YOU SEEN RASCAL?

Follow the clues and embark on an eventful scavenger hunt with Squirrel and Bear. Rascal, the cheeky badger, placed hints all over Europe. Follow the clues and use the help of your animal friends in each country.

DISCOVER THE CULTURES OF EUROPE

Take your time to explore each city. Learn foreign languages, eat delicious food, collect souvenirs, participate in traditional customs, dress fashionably and recycle trash.

CREATE MEMORIES 

Live in the moment! Gather your friends and family. Grab two controllers. Take photos, document your discoveries and create shared memories!


COOPERATIVE PLAY WITH FRIENDS 

Let your friends join. Choose between Squirrel and Bear. Combine the strengths of both characters and help each other to succeed on this colorful journey.

PACK YOUR BAGS! 

Travel by bus, train, boat, car, tanker, scooter, airplane, tram, or hot air balloon.

Play comfortably on your couch at home or take Rascal's Escape with you on the go – it's the perfect travel companion for entertainment with new friends.

Made for SteamDeck

Rascal’s Escape is perfect to bring along on your own journey. Play on the go alone. Or pair your favorite controllers to the SteamDeck to play with friends. Get comfy on the couch and connect your SteamDeck to a TV. SteamDeck and most third-party controllers are fully supported, allowing for a colorful journey anytime and everywhere.

Handcrafted by the Good Evil GmbH.
